picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant renewing UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham's MassAITC for five more years is a major vote of confidence in AI-driven aging and Alzheimer's care research, backed by serious federal funding and a strong academic-clinical partnership.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: Harvard's Belfer Center 'pre-mortem' on catastrophic AI risk, citing rogue-agent breaches and a major lab's training pause, is a timely policy intervention that could shape how governments and labs approach AI safety governance.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: A joint MIT/CMU/NYU/Stanford team built an AI that beat top human players at Stratego, a landmark for imperfect-information game AI with algorithmic implications beyond games, into negotiation and strategic decision-making.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip from the American University in Cairo that cheaply screens for cancer and other diseases from biological fluids could meaningfully expand access to early diagnostics in low-resource settings.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine-learning tool for estimating radiation exposure from a routine blood test offers a fast, accessible alternative to specialized testing, with clear real-world value for nuclear incident response and medical triage.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: Inria's Samu-Voice project, which analyzes emergency call voice patterns to detect heart attacks in real time, points toward a practical, life-saving AI application in emergency medicine.
picks.title: Samu-Voice: Analyzing voice and speech to detect acute transmural myocardial infarctions

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's 'InstructMesh,' developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users fix AI-generated 3D models before fabrication, addressing a key reliability gap in generative design workflows.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern researchers showed AI models can spot hard-to-detect precancerous colon lesions, a concrete step toward AI-assisted pathology that could catch cancers earlier.
picks.title: AI is helping pathologists find harmful lesions the eye can’t see

picks.editorial_note: A new CRADA between Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory to pursue space-based AI-inference computing for weather modeling signals growing convergence between orbital infrastructure and AI research.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling

picks.editorial_note: SDSU's binational shipbuilding research collaboration with Samsung Heavy Industries and South Korea's KEIT reflects deepening academic-industry-government ties around AI-driven manufacturing and maritime workforce development.
picks.title: SDSU launches shipbuilding research projects with South Korea, Samsung Heavy Industries | News | SDSU
